Common Questions

How do you hide desk cables without drilling into a rented desk?

Pair a clamp-on under-desk cable tray for your power strip with residue-free magnetic cable clips along the back edge. Both install and remove with zero damage.

What is the fastest way to make a tiny desk feel bigger?

Go vertical: use a monitor riser to store your keyboard underneath and a vertical laptop stand to reclaim flat tabletop space.
